neighbours.label: the token that glues a separator to a word beginning with a hard c or k sound: ' C', '/C', '-C', '(C' and Arabic ' الك'
fire: The Twin-City transit line opened in the spring.
An eruption of coronal gas (CME) hit the satellite.
المناطق الكبيرة تحتاج إلى مياه كثيرة.
Most of the rock in the Upper/Cretaceous layer is chalk.
My bike has Cane Creek brakes and a new seat.
The Tri-City Herald printed the story on its front page.
تحدث العلماء عن الآثار الكونية للحادث.
quiet: The downtown transit line opened in the spring.
An eruption of hot gas (flare) hit the satellite.
المناطق الجافة تحتاج إلى مياه كثيرة.
Most of the rock in the upper layer is chalk.
My bike has Shimano brakes and a new seat.
The Daily Herald printed the story on its front page.
تحدث العلماء عن الآثار السلبية للحادث.

notes: Card: ' C' x8, ' الك' x5, ' K' x4, 'C' x3, 'erc' x2, 'k' x2. Probe: 'C' of (CME) 0.866; '-C' of Bi-City 0.750; ' الك' 0.447-0.566; '/C' 0.386; ' C' of Cane 0.302; ' Trek' 0.149; the same frames without it 0.013-0.033. Near misses use other first letters.
